summary.text: John Taylor is the Republican candidate for Utah House of Representatives District 14 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which he faces Brandon Young (D).
A U.S. Army veteran who works as an account executive, he describes himself in a Ballotpedia survey as a constitutional conservative.

paragraphs.text: John Taylor graduated from Weber High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Weber State University in 1997.
He served in the U.S. Army from 1993 to 2004.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he grew up in Ogden as the oldest of seven children, served as a combat medic and later as an Army intelligence officer, and was deployed to Saudi Arabia in 1999 and to Bosnia with the Utah Army Guard.
He said he later completed an MBA in marketing and worked in business roles at the National Federation of Independent Business, Novo Nordisk and Myriad Genetics.
Taylor said he and his wife Carrie have been married for 31 years, have six children and have lived in Syracuse for 26 years.
Taylor advanced from the June 23, 2026 Republican primary.
His key messages included open and transparent government, including a proposal to require public hearings for large projects such as data centers, and cutting government spending and taxes.
